verdict.rationale: Windmill documents an official MCP server that lets external MCP clients such as Claude or Cursor connect and trigger the user's scripts and flows, which is the core of the story. The evidence is a single doc sentence plus a probe confirming the MCP docs page exists. missing for 10: detail on how tools are selected, exposed and scoped (e.g., token or permission scoping per MCP client), explicit coverage of connected app or integration actions as tools, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can expose my workflows or connected app actions as MCP tools that an external agent can call

citations.quote: With MCP, you can connect your favorite LLMs (like Claude, Cursor, or any MCP compatible client) to Windmill, allowing you to trigger your scripts and flows from your client chat.
